integrity: The exact multiplier is obtained by simplifying the source's own convergence ratio with its logistic period identity. A direct transverse linearization gives the same result. The bundled checker verifies the identity and an explicit subthreshold counterexample.
scientific_limitations: Only the semi-trivial cycle with zero predator release and strict finite-cycle threshold 0<h_l<eta K is classified.
Positive order-1 cycles and their basins are not classified.
Failure of the instability premise in Theorem 2.2(1) does not prove nonexistence of its claimed positive cycle.
At h_l=eta K the logistic hitting time is infinite.
title: The predator-extinction Floquet multiplier collapses to pure mortality in a weighted-harvesting Allee model
